editorial:
Imagine waking up in a place that looks like a cozy home, only to realize you are actually a pet in a giant space zoo. You follow a woman who is just trying to keep her sanity while weird aliens stare at her through a glass wall all day. The vibe is pretty heavy and strange, but it keeps you interested because you want to see if she can ever get out. It feels less like a space adventure and more like a story about loneliness and how hard it is to adapt when your whole world changes in an instant.

The acting is the best part here because the lead actress makes you feel her frustration and fear. Some parts move a bit slow, but the shocking twists make up for it. If you like stories that make you think about what it means to be human, you will love this. You should definitely stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see all the cool alien details, or you could rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night. If you are a big movie collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great move.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, you find out that the woman was not the first human captured, but the only one who survived the trip. She discovers a secret door and manages to trick her alien keeper into letting her inside the control room. Instead of escaping to Earth, she realizes the planet is dying. She ends up taking over the zoo to save the other alien creatures, becoming the new boss of the exhibit.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves strange stories about survival and aliens.
